geological_setting.note: SGM Alisitos andesite + granodiorite contact zone (H11-B85).

known_workings.note: On eastern projection of documented Cu-Fe belt; turquoise-mining toponym at site.

spectral_indication.note: Unvalidated RGB visual-screening heuristic on km-scale pale mass ~1 km W. Requires field validation.

structural_context.note: Straight NE-SW lineament ~1 km E (road vs fault scarp - field check). Requires field validation.

bedrock_exposure.note: Pale mass + hillslopes; good outcrop potential per terrain + visual classification.

access.note: MEX 2 ~2 km away; approximate road distance.

water_regulatory.note: Preliminary desk screen only; water availability is the principal regulatory risk.

land_constraints.note: SIAM titles / RAN ejidos / CONANP zoning / CONAGUA aquifers not yet screened.

disclaimer: Desk-screening ranks, NOT probabilities of mineralization. v3 shows prospectivity vs feasibility separately, never blended.
